+# 🫒 Mediterranean Dinner for Six
+**Date:** September 23, 2026  
+**Guests:** 6 people | **Dietary Notes:** All sides dairy-free
+
+---
+
+## 🌿 Starters / Mezze
+
+| Dish | Notes |
+|------|-------|
+| **Herbed Hummus with Warm Pita & Crudités** | Served with sliced cucumber, carrots, and radishes |
+| **Marinated Mixed Olives with Citrus & Herbs** | Kalamata + Castelvetrano, orange zest, rosemary, chili flakes |
+
+---
+
+## 🔥 Mains (Choose One or Serve Both)
+
+### Option 1 — Grilled Lemon-Herb Chicken Thighs *(recommended)*
+Bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs marinated in fresh lemon juice, garlic, oregano, thyme, and rosemary. Grilled over medium-high heat until golden and charred.
+
+> **Per person:** 2 thighs | **Total:** 12 thighs (~5–6 lbs)
+
+### Option 2 — Grilled Lemon-Herb Branzino Fillets
+Skin-on branzino fillets with a bright marinade of lemon, dill, garlic, capers, and olive oil. Grilled 3–4 minutes per side.
+
+> **Per person:** 1 fillet (~6 oz) | **Total:** 6 fillets (~2.5 lbs)
+
+---
+
+## 🥗 Sides *(All Dairy-Free)*
+
+### Side 1 — Classic Tabbouleh
+Fine bulgur wheat tossed with a mountain of flat-leaf parsley, fresh mint, diced tomatoes, green onions, lemon juice, and extra-virgin olive oil.
+
+### Side 2 — Roasted Mediterranean Vegetables
+Eggplant, zucchini, red bell peppers, cherry tomatoes, and red onion roasted at 425°F with garlic, olive oil, and za'atar until caramelized.
+
+### Side 3 — Lemony Orzo with Kalamata Olives & Fresh Herbs
+Orzo tossed warm with lemon zest, olive oil, halved Kalamata olives, fresh parsley, and toasted pine nuts.
+
+---
+
+## 🍯 Dessert
+
+| Dish | Notes |
+|------|-------|
+| **Honey-Drizzled Fresh Figs & Strawberries with Mint** | Simple, light, naturally dairy-free |
+| **Store-Bought Baklava** | Check label to confirm dairy-free; most traditional recipes are |
+
+---
+
+## 🛒 Grocery Shopping List
+
+### 🥩 Proteins
+- [ ] Bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs — **12 pieces (~5–6 lbs)**
+- [ ] Branzino fillets, skin-on — **6 fillets (~2.5 lbs)** *(if serving both mains)*
+
+### 🥬 Produce
+- [ ] Lemons — **8** (marinade, tabbouleh, orzo, garnish)
+- [ ] Garlic — **2 heads**
+- [ ] Fresh flat-leaf parsley — **3 large bunches**
+- [ ] Fresh mint — **1 bunch**
+- [ ] Fresh oregano — **1 bunch**
+- [ ] Fresh thyme — **1 bunch**
+- [ ] Fresh rosemary — **1 bunch**
+- [ ] Fresh dill — **1 bunch** *(for branzino)*
+- [ ] Roma or vine tomatoes — **4 medium**
+- [ ] Cherry tomatoes — **1 pint**
+- [ ] Eggplant — **2 medium**
+- [ ] Zucchini — **3 medium**
+- [ ] Red bell peppers — **2**
+- [ ] Red onions — **2 medium**
+- [ ] Green onions (scallions) — **1 bunch**
+- [ ] English cucumber — **1** *(crudités)*
+- [ ] Carrots — **1 bag** *(crudités)*
+- [ ] Radishes — **1 bunch** *(crudités)*
+- [ ] Fresh figs — **12** *(or 1 pint strawberries, or both)*
+- [ ] Oranges — **1** *(zest for marinated olives)*
+
+### 🫙 Pantry & Dry Goods
+- [ ] Extra-virgin olive oil — **1 large bottle (at least 500 ml)**
+- [ ] Fine bulgur wheat — **1 cup / ~6 oz**
+- [ ] Orzo pasta — **1 lb**
+- [ ] Tahini — **1 jar**
+- [ ] Canned chickpeas — **2 × 15 oz cans** *(for hummus)*
+- [ ] Kalamata olives — **1½ cups** *(1 cup for orzo, ½ cup for mezze)*
+- [ ] Castelvetrano olives — **1 cup** *(mezze)*
+- [ ] Capers — **1 small jar**
+- [ ] Pine nuts — **¼ cup** *(orzo garnish)*
+- [ ] Honey — **1 jar**
+- [ ] Za'atar seasoning — **1 small jar** *(roasted vegetables)*
+- [ ] Dried red chili flakes
+- [ ] Kosher salt & black pepper *(pantry staple)*
+
+### 🍞 Bread & Bakery
+- [ ] Pita bread — **8–10 rounds** *(warm before serving)*
+- [ ] Baklava (store-bought) — **1 box / ~18 pieces** *(check dairy-free label)*
+
+### 🧴 Check You Have at Home
+- [ ] Cumin *(hummus)*
+- [ ] Paprika *(hummus)*
+- [ ] Baking sheet / sheet pans (×2 for roasting)
+- [ ] Grill or grill pan
+
+---
+
+## ⏱ Day-Of Timing Guide
+
+| Time Before Serving | Task |
+|---------------------|------|
+| **Night before** | Marinate chicken (or branzino) in the fridge |
+| **2 hours before** | Make hummus; prepare marinated olives |
+| **1.5 hours before** | Make tabbouleh (needs time to soak bulgur & meld) |
+| **45 min before** | Roast Mediterranean vegetables |
+| **30 min before** | Cook orzo; prep crudités platter |
+| **20 min before** | Fire up grill; grill chicken (~35–40 min total) or branzino (~8 min) |
+| **At the table** | Arrange mezze; plate sides; slice & serve |
+
+---
+
+*Menu designed for 6 guests. All sides are confirmed dairy-free. Adjust quantities by ~15% for heartier appetites.*
